regions.text: Regions, top to bottom: header 44 (title · one status chip · one primary) → context bar 36 (connection, schema, range, period) → layer tabs 36 (scroll + More) → toolbar 36 (search, filters, count) → body → inspector 400–480. Every row is optional. Every row has one job. Never two segmented controls in one row. Board 1 measures them; boards 2–4 apply them.

overlays.text: Five things may float or slide: inspector (non-modal, beside the page, URL-addressable), slide-over (modal, every create/edit form), popover (a fact: why this number, an id's hover card, the Needs-you tray), dialog (destructive confirms), toast. One overlay layer at a time; Esc closes; focus returns; motion 160/260 ms ease-out; reduced motion ends on the finished frame.

tokens.text: Instrument's tokens are kept as they are: ground #181818, chrome #1c1b1a, inset #211e1c, rules #23211f / #2c2928, text #e9ecee / #99a2a8 / #7c878d, blue #4c9ad6, green #3eab82, amber #b88d30. What changes is the reading size — 13 px body, 12 px meta, 11 px only for mono labels and ids — and the 26 px control height everywhere.
